about.text: Renade stood for solidarity, justice and warmth. On 28.08.2025, around 2:16 a.m., she passed away peacefully — surrounded by loved ones. This page gathers memories, shares information about remembrance and donations (goal: €4,000–5,000 for a burial in the forest cemetery at Burg Plesse; any surplus will go to projects Renade was active in) and invites your solidarity.

quotes.author: Friend
quotes.text: Renade showed me what it means to be there for each other.
